message:
Running command: # Let me trace through the nohead_base64 case manually
# The PEM is:
# -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\n
# abcd\n
# -----END CERTIFICATE-----\n

# After reading the BEGIN line, name = "CERTIFICATE"
# Header loop:
#   Read "abcd\n" -> buf = "abcd\n\0", i = 5
#   Trim: buf[5]='\0' <= ' ', i=4; buf[4]='\n' <= ' ', i=3; buf[3]='d' > ' ', stop
#   buf[4]='\n', buf[5]='\0', i=5
#   buf[0]='a' != '\n', don't break
#   strncmp(buf, "-----END ", 9) != 0 (buf = "abcd\n\0"), don't set nohead
#   Copy to headerB: headerB->data[0..4] = "abcd\n", hl = 5
#   Next iteration: Read "-----END CERTIFICATE-----\n"
#   buf = "-----END CERTIFICATE-----\n\0", i = 28
#   Trim: buf[28]='\0' <= ' ', i=27; buf[27]='\n' <= ' ', i=26; ... buf[0]='-' > ' ', stop
#   buf[27]='\n', buf[28]='\0', i=28
#   buf[0]='-' != '\n', don't break
#   strncmp(buf, "-----END ", 9) == 0 -> nohead = 1, break
# hl = 5
# Data buffer: BUF_MEM_grow(dataB, 1024), dataB->data[0] = '\0'
# nohead == 1, so swap: headerB = dataB, dataB = headerB_old, bl = hl = 5
# End line check: buf = "-----END CERTIFICATE-----\n\0"
#   i = strlen("CERTIFICATE") = 10
#   strncmp(buf, "-----END ", 9) == 0 -> OK
#   strncmp("CERTIFICATE", &buf[9], 10) -> buf[9..18] = "CERTIFICATE" -> OK
#   strncmp(&buf[19], "-----\n", 6) -> buf[19..24] = "-----\n" -> OK
# EVP_DecodeUpdate(&ctx, dataB->data, &bl, dataB->data, 5)
#   Input: "abcd\n" (5 bytes)
#   'a', 'b', 'c', 'd' -> decoded to 3 bytes, written to dataB->data[0..2]
#   '\n' -> whitespace, skipped
#   Returns 1, bl = 3
# EVP_DecodeFinal(&ctx, &dataB->data[3], &k)
#   Returns 1, k = 0
# bl = 3
# bl != 0, so don't goto err
# Return 1

# So this SHOULD work. Let me check why it doesn't.
echo "Testing with explicit length..."
python3 -c "
import ctypes, os

# Create the PEM data
data = b'-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\n'
data += b'abcd\n'
data += b'-----END CERTIFICATE-----\n'

# Write to file
with open('/tmp/test_nohead.pem', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(data)
print(f'Written {len(data)} bytes')
print(f'Data: {repr(data)}')
"
